title: Thumbtack vs Angi for Contractors (2026): The Per-Booked-Job Math
h1: Thumbtack vs Angi: Which Actually Costs Less Per Booked Job?
meta: Thumbtack vs Angi for contractors: ~$250 vs ~$542 per booked job. The honest comparison on lead sharing, control, and why both lose to owned channels.
short: Per booked job, Thumbtack (~$250) usually beats Angi (~$542) — mostly because you control which leads you pay for and they're shared with fewer pros. But both are rented demand: the leads stop the day you stop paying.
statLabel: Cost per booked job: Thumbtack vs Angi (once close rates are counted)

body.answer: Thumbtack is usually cheaper per booked job — but both are rented leads.
body.html: Measured per booked job, Thumbtack runs about $250 versus Angi's ~$542. Thumbtack gives you more control (you choose which leads to pay for) and shares each lead with fewer pros, which lifts your close rate. But neither is a moat — stop paying and the leads vanish.

body.answer: Control + less sharing = a better close rate.
body.html: Angi shares a lead with as many as 12 pros; you're racing a dozen trucks to the phone, and 78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026). Thumbtack lets you filter to the jobs you actually want and competes you against fewer pros, so more of what you pay for closes.

body.answer: Rented leads can't be audited and don't compound.
body.html: HomeAdvisor's lead marketing drew a $7.2M FTC order in 2023 (FTC 2023) — a reminder you can't see how a bought lead was generated or who else got it. Leads from your Google profile, referrals, and a converting website are exclusive, cheaper per booked job, and they compound.

faq.a: Usually, per booked job: ~$250 vs Angi's ~$542. You control which Thumbtack leads you pay for and they're shared with fewer pros, so more of them close.
They can be, but with fewer pros than Angi's up-to-12 sharing, and you choose which to pursue — which is why the close rate and cost-per-booked-job are usually better.

faq.q: What's better than both Thumbtack and Angi?
faq.a: Owned channels — a complete Google Business Profile, a referral system, and a converting website. Exclusive leads, lower cost per booked job, and they don't stop when you stop paying.
